full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant to dispose of the case are that on 03.06.1994 at 08:30 p.m., one Abdul Hasnat Chowdhury, son of Monsoor Ali Mondal of village-Keshail, Police Station- Badalgachi, Naogaon, brother of the victim lodged a FIR in writing (ejahar) to the Sub-Inspector, M. A. Hamid, Badalgachi Police Station, where-upon a criminal case being Badalgachi Police Station Case No.01, dated 03.06.1994 was started and that in the said First Information Report (FIR), aforesaid Abdul Hasnat Chowdhury stated, inter-alia, that on 03.06.1994 at about 10:00 a.m. Dr. Nurul Islam with 14 others entered into the land which is described as CS Khatian No.4, Plot No.105 measuring 8.83 acres being armed with fire arms, bamboo, stick for the purpose of releasing fish and also for plantation of banana plant at the adjacent land of the pond (dighi) and having received the information, Hashem Reza Chowdhury @ Tagar accompanied with others went there and asked them to stop releasing fish and to stop plantation. At that time, they began to altercate with each other and at one stage, Dr. Nurul Islam opened fire on Hashem Reza Chowdhury @ Tagar by his fire arms and as a result of which, Tagar laid down on the ground and thereafter, accused Yakub Ali dealt lathi blow towards Rezaul who was trying to save Tagar. At the same time, accused Sabuj dealt rod blow towards Mujibur Rahman who was being injured seriously. The local people assembled on hearing hue and cry and thereafter, Dr. Nurul Islam and others fled away and afterwards, the injured persons were taken to Naogaon Hospital by ambulance and the duty doctor declared victim Tagar as dead.
